C:P2.2.text: A distinctive company with a multi-manager, multi-strategy model

C:P2.3.text: A Message from George R. Aylward President and Chief Executive Officer

C:P2.4.text: Welcome to Virtus Investment Partners, a company dedicated to being a distinctive and trusted provider of asset management solutions for individual and institutional investors.

C:P2.5.text: Our goal is to offer clients high-quality investment strategies that have generated compelling performance and meet multiple financial needs. To accomplish this, we employ a multi-manager, multi-strategy approach that delivers a broad array of solutions.

C:P2.6.text: Each of our investment partners has a distinct investment philosophy and style, with talent and discipline that have been tested through market cycles and validated by performance over time. Importantly, they all share an unwavering commitment to investor success.

C:P2.7.text: We hope you will consider joining us as a client.

C:P2.8.text: Our multi-manager, multi-strategy approach gives clients access to distinctive investment strategies from independent managers.

C:P2.9.text: We have the flexibility, agility, and responsiveness of a boutique asset management firm with the product breadth, distribution reach, and resources of larger firms.

C:P2.10.text: Our multi-boutique model is based on the fundamental belief that investment professionals who operate in an environment that allows for the appropriate focus and culture can generate sustainable, superior returns for our clients.

C:P3.1.text: AlphaSimplex Group, LLC | Virtus Investment Partners

C:P3.2.text: AlphaSimplex is a systematic alternatives manager focused on delivering quantitative investment strategies that are attuned to changing market dynamics.

C:P3.4.text: AlphaSimplex strives to help investors meet their long-term goals in ever-evolving markets by analyzing market behavior and risk. Our investment philosophy is based on the Adaptive Markets Hypothesis, an innovative theory of market behavior.

C:P3.10.text: Chief Investment Officer, Portfolio Manager Industry Start Date: 2007

C:P3.11.text: Alexander Healy is the chief investment officer and a portfolio manager at AlphaSimplex, an affiliated manager of Virtus Investment Partners. Dr. Healy is responsible for the day-to-day supervision of the research team and the implementation of the firm’s investment strategies. He is the chair of the firm’s investment committee and a member of the operating and risk committees. Additionally, he serves as a co-portfolio manager of certain funds.

C:P3.12.text: Dr. Healy joined AlphaSimplex and held the roles of senior research scientist, director of strategic research, and deputy chief investment officer. He has developed various key elements of AlphaSimplex’s investment platform, including non-parametric investment models, volatility management overlays, and dynamic approaches to portfolio construction.
